title: Use an almost-conserved direction to bound preparation time despite an existing dressed eigenstate
statement: For B=1,Q=2,a>0,lambda>0, define R_eta=(eta*sqrt(lambda),eta*lambda,1) and H_eta+I=2*R_eta^*R_eta+a*|d><d|. The target v1=(1,0,-sqrt(lambda))/sqrt(1+lambda) is an exact dressed eigenstate. For every shared scalar envelope with a well-defined unitary propagator, success probability>=p>0 from |c> requires T>=sqrt(lambda+1)/a *[sqrt(p)-sqrt(lambda)/(lambda+1)-sqrt(2-2*sqrt(lambda/(lambda+1)))]_+. At fixed p this is (sqrt(p)/a)*sqrt(lambda)-O(1).

requires: The exact three-state completed Hamiltonian, fixed bare proper-subcode penalty and only the common scalar envelope; no hidden extra drive, postselection or dissipation.
p is the desired final target probability; every finite-time envelope must define the stated unitary evolution.
provides: For B=1,Q=2,a>0,lambda>0, define R_eta=(eta*sqrt(lambda),eta*lambda,1) and H_eta+I=2*R_eta^*R_eta+a*|d><d|. The target v1=(1,0,-sqrt(lambda))/sqrt(1+lambda) is an exact dressed eigenstate. For every shared scalar envelope with a well-defined unitary propagator, success probability>=p>0 from |c> requires T>=sqrt(lambda+1)/a *[sqrt(p)-sqrt(lambda)/(lambda+1)-sqrt(2-2*sqrt(lambda/(lambda+1)))]_+. assumptions: This is a specific control-family lower bound, not a universal impossibility of loading dressed states or the corresponding larger-control interface.
Bare-penalty gap collapse alone does not establish the time bound; retain the explicit invariant-vector argument.
costs: At fixed a,p the necessary duration grows sqrt(lambda)/a. Large scalar amplitude alone cannot evade the bound; an added physical control must be acquired and charged.
contract.units: Natural units B=1,hbar=1; a*T is dimensionless, lambda and p dimensionless; bounds on amplitude and probability are distinct.
contract.obstruction: Check the actual control algebra before transferring a target-eigenstate construction into a fast preparation claim.

body: The competing fixed vector phi=(sqrt(lambda),-1,0)/sqrt(1+lambda) obeys R_eta*phi=0 for every real eta and (H_eta+I)*phi=-a*|d>/sqrt(1+lambda). Duhamel gives ||U_T*phi-phi||<=a*T/sqrt(1+lambda) after removing the common energy phase. The input distance is sqrt(2-2*sqrt(lambda/(lambda+1))); target overlap is sqrt(lambda)/(lambda+1). Triangle inequality bounds success AMPLITUDE by their sum plus a*T/sqrt(1+lambda), giving the probability-time statement. This covers nonmonotone/overshooting/piecewise schedules with integrable Hamiltonian; no adiabatic-ramp or mere gap-closing argument is needed. The target exists with zero self-connection throughout, so that existence cannot license the full-code loading bound. Independent source shaping, mixing or bath controls change the admissible algebra and can defeat this specific trap.
